_help: Where each sticker goes. width: fraction of the screen's width. anchor: the point IN the picture (0-1 across, 0-1 down) that's placed at x, y. at: 'screen' = x, y are fractions of the screen; 'mouth' = x, y are offsets from the middle of the mouth (fractions of width and height). angle: degrees clockwise. sway: gentle rocking, in degrees. enter: 'down' slides in from above, 'up' from below. tint: 'mouth' colours a grey drawing in the face's mouth colour, null keeps its own colours.
